The most visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the city’s largest and most frequented farmers‑market, drawing hundreds of thousands of visitors each week. The market’s central location, wide variety of produce, artisanal goods, and frequent events make it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
